column1: # baseline: the baseline is applied by the lint task (CLI --baseline), so the lint tasks rerun where upstream's are
# UP-TO-DATE (research/29 deviation 1); outcomes and outputs are the same.
# Linux only (first seen on the 2026-10-07 testbox run; identical on Windows): the two sides list files in different
# orders in the console and the plain/sarif reports (the same rows: rows.py). Unreviewed: whether ktrs should order
# files like upstream on every filesystem is an open item; remove these once it does. `unordered`: on CI the order
# matches in some runs and not others (2026-10-22: compose-* matched in one attempt, realcode in the next).
# realcode: the html reporter orders files by a ConcurrentHashMap keyed by absolute path, which differs between the two
# project dirs (.../upstream/... vs .../ktrs/...): same lines, an order that varies between runs (research/29).
